verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Netlify offers serverless functions for building APIs, and a partner integration references edge functions, so an on-demand compute model exists. Nothing in the pack documents instance boot times or auto-scaling limits. The "deploy in seconds" claim concerns site deployment, not instance cold-start. Missing for 10: documented sub-second cold-start/boot times, documented auto-scaling to tens of thousands of concurrent instances, and first-party edge-compute docs or independent load-testing corroboration.
